onboarding.calibration_body: Nazi izaziso zomsebenzi eziyishumi eziphilayo, kanye nalokho i-Dawnlist eyikubone ngayinye. Lungisa noma yini eyiphuthelwe. Uma ungavumelani, itshele ukuthi yiluphi usho olwalungazoyenza kahle — leyo msho ingena kwibhrifi yakho, ukuze iphutha elifanayo lingaphindwa kusasa.
onboarding.sentence_placeholder: Yimuphi umsho, ongezelela kwibhrifi yakho, owawuzokwenza lokhu kube kahle?
onboarding.finish: Qedela uphinde uqale ukusebenza nsuku zonke
onboarding.ready: Kulungile — ibhrifi yakho izobuyekezwa ngalokho okuyifundisile.
onboarding.low_signal: Uvumelane nakho konke, okuvamise ukusho ukuthi lesi sampula besilula kunokuthi ibhrifi isiphelele.

settings.title: Dawnlist — izilungiselelo
settings.key_body: I-Dawnlist ifunda izimemo zemisebenzi futhi ibhale imiyalezo yakho isebenzisa amamodeli e-Anthropic, kwi-akhawunti yakho siqu. Dala ukhiye ku-console.anthropic.com bese uwunamathisela lapha. Ungawuhoxisa noma nini, futhi i-Dawnlist iwugcina kusiphathi samagama emvume yesistimu yakho yokusebenza — akulona ifayela.
settings.key_none: Akukho khiye ogciniwe okwamanje — i-Dawnlist ayikwazi ukusebenza ngaphandle kwawo.
settings.licence_body: Namathisela ukhiye welayisensi ovela kwi-imeyili yakho yokuthenga. Uma unikwe ikhodi yokungenisa esikhundleni salokho, namathisela leyo — i-Dawnlist izoyishintshanisa ngelayisensi.
onboarding.interview_body: I-Dawnlist ifunde ama-CV akho futhi yabhala imibhalo emibili yohlaka. Ilungise — kuyisiqalo, hhayi isinqumo sokugcina. Iphepha lemininingwane ngakwesokunxele yiyona nto kuphela evunyelwe ukusetshenziswa ekufinyeleleni kwakho. Isifinyezo sokufaneleka ngakwesokudla sinquma ukuthi yini ekhonjiswayo njalo ekuseni.
onboarding.drafted: Kubhaliwe uhlaka. Lungisa noma yini engalungile ngaphambi kokuqhubeka.
onboarding.draft_failed: Akukwazekanga ukubhala uhlaka kusuka kuma-CV akho: {reason}. Ungayibhala yomibili imibhalo wena ngokwakho bese uqhubeka.
